title: Goldreich–Levin query program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\tau\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\tau\leq 1$. The query program is the membership-query learning program obtained by running the Goldreich–Levin query procedure through $n$ stages at threshold $\tau$, and it returns a state consisting of an optional active family of coordinate sets and a list of estimate records.
caveat: The query-run procedure is referenced but not defined in the supplied definitions.
